Interface EMFCandidateSelectorStrategy<K extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.ENamedElement, V extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject>

Type Parameters:
K - the type of ENamedElement used as key (e.g., EClassifier, EAttribute)
V - the type of EObject to be selected
All Known Implementing Classes:
EMFAbstractCachedRoundRobinCandidateSelector, EMFRoundRobinCandidateSelector, EMFRoundRobinEClassCandidateSelector, EMFRoundRobinEEnumLiteralCandidateSelector, EMFRoundRobinEObjectCandidateSelector, EMFRoundRobinFeatureMapGroupMemberSelector
public interface EMFCandidateSelectorStrategy<K extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.ENamedElement, V extends org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject>
Strategy interface for selecting EMF EObject candidates of a specified type.
Author:
Lorenzo Bettini

  • Method Details

    • getNextCandidate

      V getNextCandidate(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject context, K type)
      Get the next assignable candidate for the specified type.
      Parameters:
      context - the EObject whose resource set will be scanned for candidates
      type - the type of candidate to select
      Returns:
      the next candidate, or null if no candidates are available

    • hasCandidates

      boolean hasCandidates(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject context, K type)
      Check if there are any candidates available for the specified type.
      Parameters:
      context - the EObject providing the resource set context
      type - the type to check candidates for
      Returns:
      true if there are candidates available, false otherwise

    • reset

      default void reset()
      Reset the internal state of the candidate selector. The default implementation does nothing.
